thread:
Alex: taking over evening coverage, primary -> me, secondary -> Maria. quick handover below.

Alex: summary — ongoing regen-error surge hitting eu-west-1 customers. pages started ~18:02 UTC, error rate ~3.2% on /v1/generate for model-redwood-medium, p50 latency steady but p95 elevated. customer regen failures reported for two mid-market customers (ACME, PaperTrail).

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: 3 active pages. Sev2. Alerts: regen-failures-eu-west, kv-eviction-warning-eu-west, tokenstore-retry-spike. First page at 1769122800.

Alex: current mitigations in flight —
- prefetched fallback route enabled to us-east-1 for non-EU compliance customers (config: routing.policy=latency+region-fallback)
- reduced max_concurrency on primaries to shed pressure (changed at 18:10 UTC)
- temporary rate-limit bump for ACME (grace quota +10%)

Alex: active checks I ran (keep running every 5m):
```bash
# check regen error rate
curl -s http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=sum
  'increase(http_request_errors_total{path="/v1/generate",region="eu-west-1"}[5m])'
# get failing node list
kubectl -n inference get pods -l role=primsec -o wide
```

Alex: logs excerpt from primsec pod that showed the eviction jitter at 18:07 UTC:
```
[18:07:03] primsec-12: KV cache eviction triggered size=137MB threshold=128MB
[18:07:05] primsec-12: retrying tokenstore request id=0x9f3 err=ETIMEDOUT
[18:07:07] primsec-12: regen request id=0x9f4 error=backend_unavailable
```

Alex: runbooks and links — please follow these in order:
1) regen-failures playbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/regen-failures
2) primsec-eviction troubleshooting: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/primsec-eviction
3) emergency-fallback-routing doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/fallback-routing

Alex: customer impact — ACME: high (multiple failed jobs, support ticket P-433 open). PaperTrail: medium (timeouts, retries visible). No public incident yet, support has been notified and asked to hold comms until we confirm persistent degradation.

Alex: open action items for next shift (assigned):
- Maria: validate us-east fallback latencies for ACME traffic and confirm no data residency issues (ETA 18:30 UTC).
- Jamal: watch KV eviction histogram and roll primsec nodes to clear fragmentation if eviction rate stays >2/min (ETA 18:40 UTC).
- Sophia: keep tokenstore contact loop — if retries >5% escalate to SRE infra oncall (pager summary in runbook).

Maria: ack. I'll start validating fallback now, will post perf numbers and any config blockers.

Maria: quick note — I saw an authz 401 spike on one of the fallback routes, looks like a token refresh issue for supplier-account. investigating.

Alex: thanks. Maria, if authz blocks fallback, prefer traffic split instead of full cutover. small incremental shifts (10% -> 30%) and watch regen errors.

Jamal: seeing primsec-12 and primsec-15 with repeated GC spikes, eviction correlation looks strong. planning a controlled drain on primsec-12 (cordon -> drain -> replace). will wait for your go, Alex.

Alex: go for drain on primsec-12 when Maria confirms fallback health. mark maintenance in console.

Sophia: FYI tokenstore team notified, they acknowledged and are looking at a connection pool leak on their side. ETA from them ~25-30m.

Alex: escalation plan in case of customer outage widening:
- escalate to infra oncall (page INFRA-ONCALL)
- enable global read-only fallback for affected customers (follow emergency-fallback-routing doc)
- prepare status note for support (use template in runbook)

Maria: fallback perf checks: p50 ~220ms, p95 ~780ms for ACME on us-east, throughput looks OK at 50 tps. authz 401s are coming from supplier-account token cache miss — opening ticket TRACE-772.

Alex: great. Maria — if authz fix will take >30m, proceed with split traffic 20% and monitor for regen errors.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: primary changed to Alex at 1769123456. Secondary: Maria. Next handover scheduled at 1769160000.

Maria: accepted, will act as secondary and take over if Alex needs to step away.

Alex: leaving this thread pinned — I'll be available for questions, but stepping to low-touch while mitigations run. If regen error doesn't fall below 0.5% in 30m escalate per runbook. :thumbsup:

Jamal: starting drain on primsec-12 now. I'll post status updates here.

Jamal: drain complete, new pod coming up, eviction count dropped to 0.8/min after replacement.

Maria: after the swap p95 regen errors dropped to 1.1% (from 3.2%). still above target but trending down.

Alex: excellent. keep monitoring. leaving handover notes in ops doc under evening-coverage/1769123456. thanks team.

Sophia: noted. I'll keep tokenstore watch and ping if anything worsens.

Maria: taking over active watch, will escalate if thresholds cross.

Alex: handover complete.
